categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in digital video content licensing, sports event broadcasting, digital video channel operation, video-on-demand services, and media advertising. It also provides enterprise cloud video services and develops cloud-based video storage systems. The business includes self-produced programs, licensed content, and advertising services across multiple platforms including IPTV (MOD), OTT, and proprietary OTT platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages IT and cloud technologies with a proprietary ABYSS cloud video storage system for high-definition video content management. It employs advanced broadcasting technologies including 4K HD, VR, AI-assisted production, and multi-angle live streaming. The production process involves content planning, editing, marketing, and digital distribution across multiple devices and platforms, supported by big data analytics for audience insights and targeted advertising.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include IPTV platform operators, OTT streaming subscribers, advertisers, and enterprise clients requiring cloud video services. The company serves sports fans, general entertainment viewers, and corporate clients in Taiwan, with content also licensed internationally. Major partners include telecom operators and digital media platforms, targeting both individual consumers and business clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Taiwan, serving domestic markets through platforms like Chunghwa Telecom MOD and local OTT services. It also pursues international licensing and content distribution in regions including Japan, China, Southeast Asia, and Western countries. The company’s operations and partnerships are focused on Taiwan’s digital media ecosystem with expanding overseas market activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly midstream and downstream in the digital media supply chain, acting as a content producer, channel operator, and platform service provider. It licenses content from upstream rights holders and distributes to end consumers via IPTV and OTT platforms. It also integrates technology and advertising services, positioning itself as a comprehensive digital media service integrator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding sports broadcasting rights, enhancing viewer experience through AI and innovative broadcast technologies, and growing OTT subscription revenue. The company focuses on developing cloud-based video storage and big data analytics for targeted advertising. It aims to deepen partnerships, invest in sports technology, and pursue ESG initiatives for sustainable growth while exploring mergers and acquisitions to expand business scope.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily from digital video content licensing and broadcasting fees, OTT subscription income, advertising sales on owned and partner platforms, and enterprise cloud video service contracts. Additional income comes from project-based system integration, app development, and e-commerce related to digital content. The company maintains a stable cash flow through a mix of recurring subscription fees, advertising commissions, and content licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading digital media and sports broadcasting brand in Taiwan, competing with other IPTV operators, OTT platforms like Netflix, Disney+, and local streaming services. It differentiates itself through proprietary technology, exclusive sports content, and a large high-definition video library. Its strong brand recognition in sports broadcasting and integrated cloud services positions it favorably against competitors in the converging digital media market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported significant growth with 2024 revenue of approximately NT$1.49 billion, a 54% increase from the prior year, and net profit growth of 32%. It has a solid asset base exceeding NT$1 billion and equity of over NT$700 million. The company’s earnings per share increased to NT$6.85, reflecting strong profitability and operational leverage. It maintains positive cash flow and continues to invest in technology and content to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-quality, multi-platform digital video content with a focus on premium sports broadcasting, leveraging proprietary cloud storage and AI technologies to enhance viewer experience. Its extensive HD content library, exclusive sports rights, and integrated advertising solutions create a unique ecosystem that attracts and retains subscribers. The combination of innovative technology, strong brand reputation, and diversified revenue streams differentiates it in Taiwan’s competitive digital media landscape.
